current_development.summary: Studio G07 formal Skill Master registration fix: Data Exchange now owns an explicit canonical Skill Master registration contract containing schemaVersion/id/name/skillLevel/trigger/conditions/target/effects/resource/runtimeContracts. G07 asserts that contract before Dry Run and no longer derives allowed Skill fields from a possibly stale cached shared schema. Studio cache versions for skill-schema, skill-generator, and data-exchange-core were bumped. G07 build/apply APIs and visible registration labels use formal Skill naming. Unrelated unknown fields remain rejected. No files are deleted.
